integrity.proof_basis: exact finite-dimensional spectral reduction and modular counting
integrity.supplementary_check: direct finite-matrix enumeration of 55365 labelled masks and 18336 complete spectra, N=5..13, tolerance 2e-9

scientific_limitations: Only the coordinate and discrete-Fourier orthonormal bases in dimension N>=5 are treated.
Sharp deletion budgets are k=1,2,3,4; no analogous classification for k>=5 is asserted.
The standard singular-value and projection lemmas are not claimed as novel.
Full bibliographic uniqueness and independent mathematical validation are not certified.
title: Sharp four-erasure stability and the first arithmetic transition for the coordinate–Fourier frame
